question: According to the Economic Survey, 2019-20, registering property in Delhi takes ______ days.
solution:
The correct answer is __**49**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Economic Survey, 2019-20, registering property in** Delhi **takes **49 days**. 
 
• As per the survey, it takes** 68 days** to register a property in** Mumbai**.
 
• In India, it takes nine steps, at least **49 days,** and 7.4-8.1 percent of the property value to register a property.
 
• In comparison, New Zealand requires only two procedures and costs 0.1% of the property's value.
 
• According to the Economic Survey, India continues to lag behind in areas such as starting a** business (136th), registering property (154th), paying taxes (115th), and enforcing contracts (163th). **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **The Economic Survey **highlights the country's economic developments and allows for a better understanding of resource mobilisation and allocation in the Union Budget.
 
• The Survey examines developments in agricultural and industrial production, infrastructure, employment, money supply, prices, imports, exports, foreign exchange reserves, and other economic issues that affect the Budget.
 
• It is presented to Parliament ahead of the following year's budget.** **
